title: GitHub Copilot Governance: Managed Settings at Scale
description: A technical deep dive on enterprise-managed Copilot settings, MCP source and eligibility controls, team specialization, plugins, marketplaces, and graduated governance postures.
audience: platform, security, enterprise administrators, and developers
learningObjectives: Explain how managed settings delivery, precedence, and team specialization combine into an enterprise Copilot control plane.
Distinguish MCP definition sources, eligibility gates, plugin packaging, customization lockdown, and per-tool execution approval.
Compare unmanaged, flexible, very secure, and hard-lockdown postures and select an appropriate starting point for a workload.
Design team mappings that preserve enterprise guardrails without creating accidental exceptions through overlapping membership.
Adopt managed settings through a pilot, evidence review, documented exceptions, and iterative tightening.
